card.name: Compass directions and paired opposites
card.fires_on: Words in a list of paired opposites, such as 'the' or a compass direction (east, west, south) after a first direction was named. Also 'hours' in '12 hours apart' and 'Hispanic' in census race lists.

modes.label: Compass directions in lists
modes.description: The word 'the' or a direction word in a run of north, south, east and west borders or sides.
modes.example: Wajir and Isiolo to the North, Tana River to<< the>> West and Lamu to the South.

modes.label: Twelve hours apart
modes.description: The word 'hours' in a twice-daily dosing interval written as about 12 hours apart.

modes.label: Census race lists
modes.description: The word 'Hispanic' after a list of race percentages.
